'''Out From The Shadows''' was a [[Drug dealer|drug]] abuse outreach program based in the [[Jrade District/Legends|Jrade District]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The program was headed by [[Moleese]].
